title: Activity record point
description: A time-ordered sensor sample converted from internal columnar storage to an interoperable row.

timestamp.description: The sample time in ISO 8601 format.

elapsedSeconds.description: Seconds elapsed since the activity start.

latitudeDegrees.description: The latitude in decimal degrees, subject to the selected location privacy policy.

longitudeDegrees.description: The longitude in decimal degrees, subject to the selected location privacy policy.

altitudeMeters.description: The altitude above sea level in meters.

speedMetersPerSecond.description: The instantaneous speed in meters per second.

heartRateBpm.description: The heart rate in beats per minute.

cadenceRpm.description: The cadence in revolutions per minute.
